national_news.title: India and Liechtenstein Explore Bilateral Ties Under EFTA Framework
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held a bilateral meeting with Prince Alois, Acting Head of State of Liechtenstein, at Hyderabad House in New Delhi.
Discussions focused on trade, investment, science, technology, innovation, and people-to-people exchanges, building on the India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA).
Prince Alois was accorded a ceremonial reception at Rashtrapati Bhavan and paid homage to Mahatma Gandhi at Raj Ghat.

national_news.title: 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum Concludes with Unanimous Joint Declaration
bullets: The 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum concluded in New Delhi with the unanimous adoption of a Joint Declaration focused on Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation, and Sustainability.
Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla chaired the forum, highlighted the Global South's aspirations, advocated for ethical AI governance, and handed over the 2027 BRICS Parliamentary Forum Chairship to China.
Participating member nations reaffirmed their commitment to the UN Charter, peaceful resolution of international disputes, and concrete counter-terrorism actions.

national_news.title: Liechtenstein Prince Alois Holds High-Level Bilateral Talks in New Delhi
bullets: Liechtenstein's Acting Head of State, Prince Alois, arrived in New Delhi on a three-day official visit accompanied by a high-level official and business delegation.
The visit aims to provide operational momentum to the newly implemented India-EFTA Trade and Economic Partnership Agreement (TEPA).
The itinerary included bilateral discussions with PM Narendra Modi, a official banquet hosted by President Droupadi Murmu, and meetings with External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar.

national_news.title: Election Commission Defends Special Intensive Revision of Electoral Rolls in Supreme Court
bullets: The Election Commission of India (ECI) submitted a 248-page affidavit in the Supreme Court defending its Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls as fully compliant with Article 324 of the Constitution.
The poll panel rejected claims of altering statutory Form 6 used for voter registration, clarifying that declarations used during the SIR were separate administrative mapping tools.
The ECI invoked Article 324(5) regarding constitutional immunity for the Chief Election Commissioner and affirmed that all SIR orders were passed unanimously by the three-member commission.

national_news.title: PM Modi Inaugurates Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave 2026
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the three-day Emerging Science, Technology and Innovation Conclave (ESTIC) 2026 at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi.
The conclave spans 12 thematic areas—including AI, biotechnology, advanced materials, healthcare, and ocean sciences—and features exhibitions by around 150 deep-tech startups.
It launched the 'Global Connect Networking Event' bringing together over 300 global and national experts to strengthen international research collaborations and laboratory-to-market translation.

national_news.title: 9th Hero Hockey Men's Asian Champions Trophy 2026 Begins in Punjab
bullets: The 9th Hero Hockey Men’s Asian Champions Trophy 2026 kicked off in Punjab, hosted across two major venues: Olympian Surjit Hockey Stadium in Jalandhar and Olympian Balbir Singh Senior International Hockey Stadium in Mohali.
A total of six leading hockey nations are competing in the tournament: host India, Malaysia, China, Japan, South Korea, and Bangladesh.
The pool matches are being held in Jalandhar, while the semi-finals and final are scheduled to take place at the Mohali stadium on November 4th and 5th.

national_news.title: DAC Approves Defense Capital Acquisition Proposals Worth ₹2.12 Lakh Crore
bullets: The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC), chaired by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, cleared capital acquisition proposals for the Armed Forces estimated at around ₹2.12 lakh crore.
Approximately 82% of the approved procurements will be sourced from the Indian defense industry to enhance indigenous manufacturing.

Major approvals include High Mobility Vehicles, Light Multi Role Helicopters, Long Range Kamikaze Drone Systems, VSHORADS, Active Offboard Decoy Systems for the Navy, and Mobile X-Band Doppler Weather Radars for the Air Force.

national_news.title: Commerce Ministry Extends RELIEF Scheme for Exporters to March 2027
bullets: The Department of Commerce extended Component II of the Resilience and Logistics Intervention for Export Facilitation (RELIEF) scheme under the Export Promotion Mission until March 31, 2027.

The scheme provides 95% risk coverage through the Export Credit Guarantee Corporation of India (ECGC) for export shipments navigating geopolitical disruptions and maritime logistics risks in West Asia and the Gulf region.

Eligible cargo categories include Full Container Load (FCL), Less than Container Load (LCL), and refrigerated containers, while protecting exporter premium rates against surge hikes beyond pre-disruption levels.

national_news.title: ISRO Announces Expansion with Four Functional Launch Pads by 2029
bullets: ISRO Chairman V Narayanan announced that India will have four functional launch pads by 2029 to meet global satellite launch demands.
Plans include a 2,000-acre dedicated Small Satellite Launch Vehicle (SSLV) complex at Kulasekarapattinam in Tamil Nadu's Tuticorin district and a third launch pad at Sriharikota.

ISRO plans to conduct the first uncrewed Gaganyaan test within two months, followed by two more uncrewed tests before the crewed mission, alongside a collaborative lunar mission Chandrayaan-5 with Japan.

national_news.title: EAM S Jaishankar Emphasizes Zero Tolerance for Terrorism and Calls for Reformed Multilateralism
bullets: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar stated that terrorism as an instrument of statecraft is unacceptable and cannot be justified or rationalised.
Highlighted the Global South's '4F' crisis encompassing finance, fuel, food, and fertiliser, urging the Global North to share equal responsibility.
Reiterated India's stance that dialogue and diplomacy are the sole solutions to global conflicts like Ukraine and West Asia, and called for reformed multilateralism at the United Nations.

national_news.title: PM Modi Inaugurates RBI's Data Centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute in Bhubaneswar
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) Data Centre and Cybersecurity Training Institute in Bhubaneswar, Odisha.
Highlighted major financial inclusion milestones including nearly 60 crore Jan Dhan accounts and credit expansion via Mudra Yojana and PM SVANidhi.
Emphasized the critical role of modern computing infrastructure and specialized cybersecurity training in protecting India's expanding digital financial system from cyber threats.

national_news.title: GeM Promotes 'The AABHAR Collection' to Showcase India's Cultural Heritage and Support Local Artisans
bullets: Government e-Marketplace (GeM) is promoting 'The AABHAR Collection', a dedicated digital storefront featuring 294 product listings from 10 State and Central Handloom and Handicraft Emporiums.
Integrates products associated with the One District, One Product (ODOP) initiative and Geographical Indication (GI) tags into public procurement.
Aims to provide effective market linkages for artisans, weavers, rural entrepreneurs, and women-led enterprises for government gifting requirements.

national_news.title: Union Health Ministry Observes Vigilance Awareness Week 2026
bullets: The Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare observed Vigilance Awareness Week 2026 with an Integrity Pledge-taking ceremony administered by Union Health Minister JP Nadda in New Delhi.
Observed from October 26 to November 1, 2026, coinciding with the birth anniversary week of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.
The theme for the 2026 observance is 'Probity for Prosperity', emphasizing honesty, transparency, and ethical conduct in public administration.

national_news.title: Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva Wins Fourth Term as President of Brazil
bullets: Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva won Brazil's presidential runoff election, securing 51% of the total vote to defeat Flavio Bolsonaro.
This marks an unprecedented fourth non-consecutive presidential term for Lula, making him the only politician in modern Brazilian history to achieve this milestone.
At 80 years of age, Lula becomes the oldest president to be sworn into office since Brazil restored its democracy.

national_news.title: EAM S Jaishankar Addresses Chinmaya Mission Event, Highlights '4F' Crisis in Global South
bullets: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar addressed an event marking the 75th anniversary of the Chinmaya Mission in New Delhi.
Highlighted that the Global South is currently facing a '4F' crisis comprising finance, fuel, food, and fertiliser challenges.
Reiterated zero tolerance for terrorism as an instrument of statecraft and called for reformed multilateralism at the United Nations.

bihar_news.title: IndiGo Launches Direct Gaya-Bangkok Flight to Boost Buddhist Tourism in Bihar
bullets: IndiGo launched its first non-stop twice-weekly international flight connecting Gaya directly with Bangkok, Thailand, aimed at boosting Buddhist pilgrimage tourism in Bodh Gaya.
The new direct service seeks to strengthen international cultural and tourism ties while supporting local businesses and transport operators in the Magadh region.
Gaya Airport's international network also expanded with recent flights added by Thai Airways and Thai AirAsia, along with increased domestic services by Air India under the winter schedule.

bihar_news.title: PMFME Scheme Boosts Youth Entrepreneurship in Sheikhpura, Bihar
bullets: Sanjeet Barnwal, a resident of Sheikhpura, established a successful mushroom production business supported by the Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) scheme.
The business supplies packaged mushrooms to Sheikhpura, neighbouring districts like Lakhisarai, Nawada, and Jamui, and markets in West Bengal.
The initiative has enabled him to achieve financial independence and create livelihood opportunities for approximately 12 local people.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Museum Ranks 9th Globally and 1st in Asia
bullets: The Bihar Museum in Patna secured the 9th rank among the world's 100 best museums and the 1st rank in Asia in 2026.
Developed with the involvement of Lord Cultural Resources (a Canadian consultancy), its foundation stone was laid in June 2013 and it was fully dedicated to the public in 2017.
The museum houses historical artefacts, ancient coins, manuscripts, and folk art, and an underground tunnel of 1.5 km is planned to connect it with the historic Patna Museum.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Partners with IT Companies to Train Government School Teachers in AI
bullets: Bihar’s Education Department partnered with 11 IT firms, including Google Education, to provide training in artificial intelligence and digital technologies to government school teachers.
Centralised training will be conducted at the State Council of Educational Research and Training (SCERT) campus with arrangements expected to be in place by January.
The state also plans to make computer education compulsory from Class 6 in government schools and introduce smart classrooms across 700 model schools.

bihar_news.title: Supreme Court Allows Ayurvedic Lecturers' Appeals Against Termination in Bihar
bullets: The Supreme Court allowed appeals by Ayurvedic lecturers against the termination of their services under the Bihar Private Medical (Indian System of Medicine) College (Taking over) Act, 1985.
The Court ruled that eligibility for absorption should be assessed based on the cutoff date of June 1, 1986, rather than the initial appointment date.
The judgment quashed previous High Court rulings and ordered the reinstatement of appellants with consequential benefits including pensions.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Education Department Issues Deadline for Science Laboratory Construction in Schools
bullets: Bihar education authorities issued show-cause notices to RailTel and Telecommunications Consultants India Ltd (TCIL) over delays in constructing science laboratories in government schools.
Out of 2,199 targeted schools under the Samagra Shiksha scheme, laboratories were completed in only 351 schools, prompting a strict deadline of November 30.
RailTel and TCIL are responsible for executing the turnkey projects across assigned districts, which include supplying physics, chemistry, and biology laboratory equipment and furniture.
